question.text: The incorrect statement regarding ethyne is

options.text: The \(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C}\) bonds in ethyne is shorter than that in ethene
The corbon - carbon bonds in ethyne is weaker than that in ethene

solution.text:
The carbon-carbon bonds in ethyne is stronger than that in ethene.
$(\mathrm{H}-\mathrm{C} \equiv \mathrm{C}-\mathrm{H})$ Ethyne is linear and carbon atoms are SP hybridised.
